## Motivation

Fixes #45697.

The Kimi K3 tool-call parser (`kimi_k3`) does not stream tool-call arguments: the whole call is buffered until `<|close|>call`, so clients see one giant blob at the end instead of incremental argument deltas.

## Modifications

- Rewrote `KimiK3Detector.parse_streaming_increment` in `python/sglang/srt/function_call/kimik3_detector.py` as an event-driven scan over the tools section: emits a `ToolCallItem` with the tool name as soon as an `<|open|>call` tag completes, then streams parameters as incremental JSON deltas.
- String argument values stream per fragment (JSON-escaped, holding back partial-marker suffixes via `kimik3_format.partial_suffix_len` so a chunk boundary can never emit text that becomes a marker); non-string values stay buffered until their close tag and are JSON-decoded as before.
- Concatenated deltas are byte-identical to the non-streaming `json.dumps(arguments, ensure_ascii=False)` output (verified), and `prev_tool_call_arr` / `streamed_args_for_tool` stay in sync for `serving_chat`'s end-of-stream flush logic.
- `detect_and_parse` is unchanged.
- Updated `test/registered/function_call/test_kimik3_detector.py` streaming tests to the delta contract and added 6 new tests: name-at-open, deltas-before-close, byte-identity with tricky content (quotes/unicode/partial-marker-like text, chunk sizes 1/7/23), non-string buffering, zero-arg call.

## Accuracy Tests

- Full sglang suite unrunnable in this env (no GPU; xgrammar/torch unavailable).
- Ran the repo's `test/registered/function_call/test_kimik3_detector.py` (23 tests incl. 6 new streaming tests) against the REAL detector code via a lightweight stub harness (stubs only for xgrammar, protocol models, base_format_detector, FunctionCallParser, ci_register): 23/23 pass.
- 180-seed random-chunking fuzz (chunk sizes 1..64) over multi-call streams with tricky content: every run reassembled byte-identical to `json.dumps` and to `detect_and_parse` output, and final serving-layer bookkeeping (`streamed == json.dumps(decoded)`) held exactly.
- Edge cases verified: mid-argument truncation (finish warns, no crash, no bogus flush), empty tool-name call skipped, orphan call-open abandoned without hang, zero-arg call emits `{}`, plain-text streaming unchanged.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- Perf: 20KB argument stream processed in ~11ms with 558 incremental deltas (previously 1 buffered blob).

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Notes

- Branch build note: `push_branch.py`'s ref-create to upstream HEAD (780a5b1a) 404s on this fork for ANY upstream commit (verified even a 12-day-old one) while fork-local shas work, so the branch was built manually via the Git Data API: commit e1b39b33 parented on the fork's main acc15c19 (strict ancestor of upstream main, verified via compare) with tree = fork-main tree + the 2 changed files, DCO sign-off included. PR three-dot diff vs sgl-project/sglang main verified clean: exactly the 2 changed files (+247/-21 detector, +156/-8 tests); GitHub's PR merge for CI will test upstream HEAD + these changes.
- Collision check passed: no open/merged PR references issue #45697 (body search + issue timeline both clean).

+    def _emit_arg_delta(self, calls: List[ToolCallItem], delta: str) -> None:

+        if not delta:
+            return

+        self.streamed_args_for_tool[tool_id] += delta
+        calls.append(ToolCallItem(tool_index=tool_id, name=None, parameters=delta))
+
+    def _stream_section_step(
+        self, section: str, cursor: int, calls: List[ToolCallItem]
+    ) -> int | None:
+        """Consume one complete streaming event at ``cursor``.
+
+        Returns the new cursor, or None when no complete event is available
+        yet and the parser must wait for more text.
+        """
+        state = self._stream_call
+        if state is None:
+            return self._stream_call_open(section, cursor, calls)
+        if state["skip"]:
+            close_idx = section.find(CALL_CLOSE, cursor)
+            if close_idx == -1:

+    def _stream_call_open(
+        self, section: str, cursor: int, calls: List[ToolCallItem]
+    ) -> int | None:

+        m = _CALL_OPEN_RE.search(section, cursor)
+        if m is None:
+            return None
+        tool_name = _parse_attrs(m["attrs"]).get("tool", "")
+        cursor = m.end()
+        if not tool_name:

+            self._stream_call = {"skip": True}
+            return cursor
+        self.current_tool_id += 1
+        tool_id = self.current_tool_id

+            self.prev_tool_call_arr.append({})
+        while len(self.streamed_args_for_tool) <= tool_id:
+            self.streamed_args_for_tool.append("")

+        # it at end-of-stream to flush any unstreamed remainder.
+        decoded: dict = {}
+        self.prev_tool_call_arr[tool_id] = {"name": tool_name, "arguments": decoded}
+        self.streamed_args_for_tool[tool_id] = ""
+        self._stream_call = {
+            "decoded": decoded,
+            "in_arg": False,
+            "arg_key": "",
+            "arg_type": "string",
+            "arg_pending": "",
+            "arg_raw": "",
+            "saw_arg": False,
+            "skip": False,
+        }
+        calls.append(ToolCallItem(tool_index=tool_id, name=tool_name, parameters=""))
+        return cursor
+
+    def _stream_call_body(
+        self,
+        section: str,
+        cursor: int,
+        calls: List[ToolCallItem],
+        state: dict,
+    ) -> int | None:
+        """Handle an open call between arguments: argument open or call close."""
+        arg_m = _ARG_OPEN_RE.search(section, cursor)
+        close_idx = section.find(CALL_CLOSE, cursor)
+        # A new call opening before this one closed is malformed; abandon the
+        # current call and reprocess the orphan open tag as a new call.
+        orphan_m = _CALL_OPEN_RE.search(section, cursor)
+        first = min(
+            [
+                (m.start(), kind)
+                for m, kind in (
+                    (arg_m, "arg"),
+                    (orphan_m, "orphan"),
+                )
+                if m is not None
+            ]
+            + ([(close_idx, "close")] if close_idx != -1 else []),
+            default=None,
+        )
+        if first is None:
+            return None
+        _, kind = first
+        if kind == "orphan":
+            assert orphan_m is not None
+            logger.warning(
+                "Kimi K3 call opened before previous call closed; "
+                "abandoning incomplete call"
+            )
+            self._stream_call = None
+            return cursor
+        if kind == "close":
+            decoded = state["decoded"]
+            self._emit_arg_delta(
+                calls, "{}" if not decoded and not state["saw_arg"] else "}"
+            )
+            self._stream_call = None
+            assert close_idx != -1
+            return close_idx + len(CALL_CLOSE)
+        assert arg_m is not None
+        attrs = _parse_attrs(arg_m["attrs"])
+        key = attrs.get("key", "")
+        arg_type = attrs.get("type", "string")
+        prefix = "{" if not state["decoded"] else ", "
+        delta = prefix + json.dumps(key, ensure_ascii=False) + ": "
+        if arg_type == "string":
+            delta += '"'
+        self._emit_arg_delta(calls, delta)
+        state.update(
+            in_arg=True,
+            arg_key=key,
+            arg_type=arg_type,
+            arg_pending="",
+            arg_raw="",
+            saw_arg=True,
+        )
+        return arg_m.end()
+
+    def _stream_argument_body(
+        self,
+        section: str,
+        cursor: int,
+        calls: List[ToolCallItem],
+        state: dict,
+    ) -> int | None:
+        """Stream one argument's value until its close tag."""
+        key = state["arg_key"]
+        if state["arg_type"] == "string":
+            # The close marker may start inside the held-back pending text
+            # (a chunk boundary can split it), so search the concatenation
+            # of pending + newly arrived section text, not the section alone.
+            pending = state["arg_pending"]
+            tail = section[cursor:]
+            combined = pending + tail
+            close_idx = combined.find(ARGUMENT_CLOSE)
+            if close_idx == -1 and not tail:
+                # Everything already consumed; waiting for more text.
+                return None
+            if close_idx != -1:
+                raw = state["arg_raw"] + combined[:close_idx]
+                self._emit_arg_delta(calls, _json_escape_fragment(combined[:close_idx]))
+                self._emit_arg_delta(calls, '"')
+                state["decoded"][key] = raw
+                state["in_arg"] = False
+                state["arg_pending"] = ""
+                state["arg_raw"] = ""
+                # The marker overlaps `pending`, so only the part past it
+                # advances the section cursor. (The marker always extends
+                # past pending: pending is a *proper* marker prefix.)
+                return cursor + (close_idx + len(ARGUMENT_CLOSE) - len(pending))
+            # Hold back a trailing partial marker so a chunk boundary can
+            # never emit text that turns out to be `<|close|>argument<|sep|>`.
+            # The held-back tail lives only in arg_pending; the cursor
+            # advances past it so it is never processed twice. arg_raw
+            # accumulates the full raw value for the decoded-arguments dict.
+            hold = partial_suffix_len(combined, [ARGUMENT_CLOSE])
+            emit_raw, state["arg_pending"] = (
+                combined[: len(combined) - hold],
+                combined[len(combined) - hold :],
+            )
+            state["arg_raw"] += emit_raw
+            self._emit_arg_delta(calls, _json_escape_fragment(emit_raw))
+            return len(section)

+        if close_idx == -1:

+            return None
+        raw = section[cursor:close_idx]
+        try:
+            value = json.loads(raw)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            value = raw
+        state["decoded"][key] = value
+        self._emit_arg_delta(calls, json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False))
+        state["in_arg"] = False
+        return close_idx + len(ARGUMENT_CLOSE)

+def test_streaming_name_emitted_at_call_open() -> None:
+    """The tool name must be emitted as soon as the call open tag completes,
+    before any argument bytes arrive."""
+    detector = KimiK3Detector()
+    tools = [_make_tool("python")]
+    open_tag = '<|open|>call tool="python" index="1"<|sep|>'
+    text, calls = _stream(detector, _chunks(TOOLS_OPEN + open_tag, 7), tools)
+    assert text == ""
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+    assert calls[0].tool_index == 0
+    assert calls[0].name == "python"
+    assert calls[0].parameters == ""
+
+
+def test_streaming_arguments_flow_before_call_close() -> None:
+    """Regression test for the buffered-until-close bug: argument deltas must
+    arrive while the call is still open, not only after <|close|>call."""
+    detector = KimiK3Detector()
+    tools = [_make_tool("write_file")]
+    body = "x" * 500  # long enough that several chunks carry argument text
+    block = _call_block("write_file", 1, {"content": ("string", body)})
+    call_close = "<|close|>call<|sep|>"
+    head, _ = block.split(call_close)
+    # Stream everything except the final <|close|>call<|sep|>.
+    text, calls = _stream(detector, _chunks(TOOLS_OPEN + head, 11), tools)
+    assert text == ""
+    streamed_params = "".join(call.parameters for call in calls)
+    assert streamed_params != "", "no argument deltas arrived before call close"
+    assert streamed_params.startswith('{"content": "')
+    # Now close the call and check final assembly.
+    _, tail_calls = _stream(detector, [call_close, TOOLS_CLOSE], tools)
+    calls.extend(tail_calls)
+    assembled = _assemble(calls)
+    assert assembled[0]["name"] == "write_file"
+    assert assembled[0]["parameters"] == json.dumps(
+        {"content": body}, ensure_ascii=False
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [1, 7, 23])
+def test_streaming_deltas_byte_identical_with_tricky_content(
+    chunk_size: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Concatenated deltas must equal json.dumps(arguments) exactly, even with
+    quotes, newlines, unicode, and text that looks like a partial marker."""
+    detector = KimiK3Detector()
+    tools = [_make_tool("python")]
+    args = {
+        "code": 'print("héllo\\nworld") 😀',
+        "tricky": "ends with partial <|close|>argument plus more",
+        "n": ("number", "42"),
+        "flag": ("boolean", "true"),
+        "obj": ("object", '{"a": [1, 2]}'),
+        "bad": ("object", "{not json"),
+    }
+    block = _call_block(
+        "python",
+        1,
+        {
+            "code": ("string", args["code"]),
+            "tricky": ("string", args["tricky"]),
+            "n": args["n"],
+            "flag": args["flag"],
+            "obj": args["obj"],
+            "bad": args["bad"],
+        },
+    )
+    expected = {
+        "code": args["code"],
+        "tricky": args["tricky"],
+        "n": 42,
+        "flag": True,
+        "obj": {"a": [1, 2]},
+        "bad": "{not json",
+    }
+    text = TOOLS_OPEN + block + TOOLS_CLOSE
+    _, calls = _stream(detector, _chunks(text, chunk_size), tools)
+    assembled = _assemble(calls)
+    assert assembled[0]["parameters"] == json.dumps(expected, ensure_ascii=False)
+    # ... and it matches the non-streaming path exactly.
+    non_streaming = KimiK3Detector().detect_and_parse(text, tools)
+    assert assembled[0]["parameters"] == non_streaming.calls[0].parameters
+
+
+def test_streaming_non_string_arg_buffered_until_close() -> None:
+    """Non-string argument values are decoded at their close tag; the value
+    must not be streamed before it."""
+    detector = KimiK3Detector()
+    tools = [_make_tool("python")]
+    block = _call_block("python", 1, {"code": ("string", "a"), "n": ("number", "42")})
+    arg_close = "<|close|>argument<|sep|>"
+    parts = block.split(arg_close)
+    assert len(parts) == 3  # two arguments, each with a close tag
+    head = parts[0] + arg_close + parts[1]  # up to, excluding, n's close tag
+    tail = arg_close + parts[2]
+    # Stream up to (excluding) the number argument's close tag.
+    _, calls = _stream(detector, _chunks(TOOLS_OPEN + head, 9), tools)
+    assembled = _assemble(calls)
+    assert assembled[0]["parameters"].endswith(', "n": ')
+    # After the close tag the decoded value streams as one delta.
+    _, tail_calls = _stream(detector, [arg_close + tail], tools)
+    calls.extend(tail_calls)
+    assembled = _assemble(calls)
+    assert json.loads(assembled[0]["parameters"]) == {"code": "a", "n": 42}
+
+
+def test_streaming_zero_arg_call() -> None:
+    detector = KimiK3Detector()
+    tools = [_make_tool("ping")]
+    text = (
+        TOOLS_OPEN
+        + '<|open|>call tool="ping" index="1"<|sep|><|close|>call<|sep|>'
+        + TOOLS_CLOSE
+    )
+    _, calls = _stream(detector, _chunks(text, 5), tools)
+    assembled = _assemble(calls)
+    assert assembled[0]["name"] == "ping"
+    assert assembled[0]["parameters"] == "{}"
+
+
 def test_stream_end_reports_truncated_tools_section(caplog) -> None:
     """A tools section cut off before its closing tag used to vanish at
     end-of-stream: no call, no text, no log. It must at least be reported."""
     detector = KimiK3Detector()
     tools = [_make_tool("python")]
     truncated = TOOLS_OPEN + '<|open|>call tool="python" index="1"<|sep|>'
     text, calls = _stream(detector, _chunks(truncated, 7), tools)
-    assert calls == []
+    # The name is emitted as soon as the call open tag completes, even though
+    # the call itself never completes.
+    assert [call.name for call in calls] == ["python"]
+    assert [call.parameters for call in calls] == [""]
     with caplog.at_level("WARNING", logger="sglang.srt.function_call.kimik3_detector"):
         result = detector.finish(tools)
     assert result.calls == []
